result.title: A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition
result.summary: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 面向印度手语识别，提出融合运动学条件自适应 GCN 与距离感知 Elastic Transformer 的混合框架，用熵驱动 SVD 采样挑选关键帧，并新建 120 类原生数据集，报告 89.8% 准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 熵驱动关键帧采样与针对不规则时间间隔的连续双位置编码，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、稀疏帧下的位置与缓存表示提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 推理。
